verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly documents a 'Bring your own agent' feature letting users connect their own AI coding agent or scripts directly to the app's sandbox, and the backend-as-code design is highlighted as friendly to external AI agents. However, this is only first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on verification of how well an external agent 'drives the builder' compared to the built-in one. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation, details on how full control transfers to the external agent vs the built-in one.
